== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-rebelsquadleader-PC-Errata-disc-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Rebel Squad Leader (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): Same game text. This is a full card image with the printed art, lore and title. There is no title strip and no “E”; a small round bronze disc sits in the lower right corner of the card.

The earlier slip and the same area of the new card image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
